Account: Pinnacle Care System — West Div.
Product: Immunexa
Round: 1
Offer summary: We proposed $88.39/dose with volume-tier discounting kicking in at 25k+ doses, plus a service-level guarantee for delivery windows. This represents a 4% concession from our initial position.

Customer position: Signalled openness to structural alternatives. Their contracting lead emphasized the importance of clinical value alignment in this cycle. Notable that the clinical committee has been vocal on preference.

Competitive backdrop: CoreVax Elite Adjuvant continues to be visible in this account. Their reported offer is roughly at parity on unit pricing. However, they have not matched our clinical education support offering.

Recommended next step: Escalate a small price movement paired with extended terms.

Negotiation deck — Round 2
Customer: Pinnacle Care System — West Div.
Product line: Immunexa

Position going in: We are approximately 4% higher versus CoreVax Elite Adjuvant's current offer. Their team knows this and is using it as leverage. Our differentiation continues to be in clinical outcomes data for high-risk cohorts.

What we offered: $86.23 per dose plus a dedicated account service commitment. This preserves margin discipline while offering non-price value.

Customer counter: Wants to defer decision pending internal review. Their Sarah from procurement was the primary voice; the clinical members were more measured.

Signal: Clear intent to switch unless we move materially.

Recommendation: Walk if they don't move; margins under pressure.
